canDoYue: 你識講刻結婚日期同首字母 G 同 M，十四個字超咗十二個，普通字體免費，核對刻字，簽表，三日後取。
canDoEn: Engrave a wedding date with initials G and M, drop the dots when fourteen characters pass the twelve-character limit, choose a free plain font, check the text, sign the form, and collect it in three days.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: I'd like to engrave our wedding date inside this silver bracelet. It's a gift.
dialogue.glossYue: 我想喺呢隻銀手鏈入面刻我哋嘅結婚日期。呢份係禮物。
dialogue.say: I'd like to engrave our wedding date inside this silver bracelet. It's a gift.

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Sure. We can fit up to twelve characters. What's the date?
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。最多十二個字。日期係幾多？
dialogue.say: Sure. We can fit up to twelve characters. What's the date?

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: The twelfth of June, 2021. Can you also add our initials, G and M?
dialogue.glossYue: 二零二一年六月十二號。可唔可以加我哋嘅首字母 G 同 M？
dialogue.say: The twelfth of June, 2021. Can you also add our initials, G and M?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Yes. "12.06.2021 G&M" is fourteen characters, so it's two over the limit.
dialogue.glossYue: 「12.06.2021 G&M」係十四個字，超咗上限兩個。
dialogue.say: Yes. "12.06.2021 G&M" is fourteen characters, so it's two over the limit.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Then just the date and initials without dots, please. Is there an extra fee?
dialogue.glossYue: 咁就淨係日期同首字母，唔好有點。有冇額外費用？
dialogue.say: Then just the date and initials without dots, please. Is there an extra fee?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: A plain font is free. A script font is fifty dollars extra.
dialogue.glossYue: 普通字體免費。花體字要額外五十蚊。
dialogue.say: A plain font is free. A script font is fifty dollars extra.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Plain is fine. Can I check the engraving text before you cut it?
dialogue.glossYue: 普通字體就得。刻之前我可唔可以核對段字？
dialogue.say: Plain is fine. Can I check the engraving text before you cut it?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Of course. Please sign this form, and it'll be ready in three days.
dialogue.glossYue: 當然可以。請簽呢張表，三日後可以取。
dialogue.say: Of course. Please sign this form, and it'll be ready in three days.
